name: feature-name word cycle on hard-cut colour cards
looks: Three feature words hard-cut in turn, each full-bleed on its own flat colour field (blue, then a motion-blurred glitch wash, then dark with an accent word), landing on the beat with no crossfade between them.
build: kinetic-word-run, simplified: one DOM clip per word, swapped on a hard cut exactly on the beat; between two of the cuts a short motion-blur/double-exposure wipe (overlapping duplicate layers at low opacity, offset a few frames) stands in for a transition.
sound: A hit on each cut, a glitch texture under the blurred wipe.
prompt: Name three features as single words, one per flat-colour full-bleed card, hard-cut on the beat with no crossfade. Use a short motion-blurred glitch wipe between two of the cuts to vary the rhythm, and give the field a different colour each time.
